This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual /Physical Mode).

2. This is a bail application U/S.439 of Cr.P.C. by the petitioner for grant of bail in connection with C.T. Case No.293/88 of 2022 arising out of Jaipatna P.S. Case No.301 of 2022 pending in the file of learned Addl.

Sessions Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Bhawanipatna for commission of offences punishable under Sections 363/366/376(1) of the IPC read with Section 4 of POCSO Act on the main allegation of kidnapping the victim and committing rape and penetrative sexual assault upon the victim.

3. Heard Mr.J.Panda, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr.S.S.Pradhan, learned AGA in the matter.
4.

After having considered the rival submissions made and taking into consideration the nature and gravity of accusations raised against the petitioner and on going through the statement of the victim and taking into account the other materials placed on record including the pretrial detention of the petitioner since 16.08.2022, this Court admits the petitioner to bail.

5. Hence, the bail application of the petitioner stands allowed and the petitioner is allowed to go on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two solvent sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin of the case on such terms and conditions as deem fit and proper by it with following conditions:-

Dillip Naik @ Suresh Naik vs State Of Odisha ... Opposite Party on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56032642/
1 (i) the petitioner shall not commit any offence while on bail,
(ii) the petitioner shall attend the trial Court on each date of posting without fail unless his attendance is dispensed with,
(iii) the petitioner shall not leave the jurisdiction of the trial Court without prior permission till disposal of the case and It is clarified that the Court in seisin of the case will be at liberty to cancel the bail of the petitioner without further reference to this Court, if any of the above conditions are violated or a case for cancellation of bail is otherwise made out.
